ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New client, Enquiry and later stages need Referral source.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_client", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Initial meeting booked", 2, "Initial meeting held", 3, "Fee proposal", 4, "Agreement out", 5, "Client won", 6, 0) >= 1, ISBLANK(TEXT(Referral_source__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Referral source before moving to Enquiry.
